shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
upright slab/monolith format with vertical orientation
standing anthropomorphic figure occupying the central field
horizontal band(s) of pattern crossing the field
justification: Both are upright stone slabs whose central field is dominated by a single large standing anthropomorphic figure, with subsidiary circle/disc and repeated small rounded motifs and horizontal banding around it. But the manner is wholly different: A is a coarse, heavily eroded, bulbous volumetric carving with barely legible schematic forms, while B is a crisp, shallow, highly finished relief with fine incised feather, hair and rosette detail and a clear narrative scene of a winged figure beside a stylised plant.
